summary: Implemented the software boundary for durable MQTT-to-PostgreSQL ingestion: payloads are committed to a local SQLite WAL spool before manual QoS acknowledgement, then replayed to PostgreSQL in FIFO order with event_id idempotency, capacity visibility and named-volume persistence.
